note: SPG93 is confirmed in OMIM as an autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia caused by NFU1, consistent with overlapping complex spasticity-ataxia spectrum phenotypes.

evidence.text: Autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia-93 (SPG93) is established as being caused by mutations in NFU1, fitting into the recognized group of hereditary spastic paraplegias.

source.title: 620938 - SPASTIC PARAPLEGIA 93, AUTOSOMAL ...
source.quote: autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia-93 (SPG93) is caused by homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the NFU1 gene (608100) on chromosome 2p13.

evidence.text: Hereditary spastic paraplegias frequently overlap clinically with cerebellar ataxia and neuropathy as part of a continuous ataxia-spasticity spectrum with shared underlying pathways.

source.title: Overcoming the divide between ataxias and spastic paraplegias: shared phenotypes, genes, and pathways
source.quote: The concept of a continuous ataxia-spasticity disease spectrum is further supported by ataxias and hereditary spastic paraplegias sharing not only overlapping phenotypes and underlying genes, but also common cellular pathways and disease mechanisms.
